core.public_claim: Single-pass Supa A-series core: 43/64 Showcase (tuning-split checkpoint evaluation), 125/192 previously inspected Stability, 168/256 combined. Requires greedy decoding and trust_remote_code=True. Sealed TEST not run.

abstention.selection_status: POST-HOC fourth gate chosen after the S1 confirmatory Stability run; its threshold itself was selected on Showcase only
abstention.known_deviation: The model class applies the offset at every decode step; the tuned gate was defined on the first generated token. No mid-answer UNKNOWN was observed on the 256-row evaluation.

stability192.role: previously inspected validation; S4 was added after the S1 confirmatory run, threshold selected on Showcase only

offline_gate_reference.caveat: Do not inherit 46/64 to this checkpoint. Two rows drifted during BF16 LoRA folding and one additional showcase row differs because the checkpoint applies the offset at every decode step.

no_bias_control.note: This control is weight-identical to Supa Core 1.7 and Supa-A1. It is evidence, not a distinct Nimbus model.

limits: Showcase64 selected the threshold; it is not untouched test data.
S4 was added after Stability had been inspected for S1; its threshold used Showcase only.
The 125/192 gain over the 121/192 no-bias control has exact McNemar p=0.2188.
The threshold is calibrated to this model, adapter scale, prompt, and class mix.
Serving stacks that reject remote code need an equivalent logits processor.

supersedes.reason: Identical recipe stored in float16 instead of bfloat16. FP16 keeps 97.8% of the merged LoRA delta against BF16's 82.8% at the same file size, scores 45/64 Showcase against A1's 43, matches 125/192 Stability, and reproduces the offline gate on 256/256 rows where A1 disagreed on 5.

core.public_claim: Single-pass Supa A-series core, float16 store: 45/64 Showcase (tuning-split checkpoint evaluation), 125/192 previously inspected Stability, 170/256 combined. Abstention is a constant logit offset, not a weight. Requires greedy decoding, float16 load, and trust_remote_code=True. No statistical significance is claimed. Sealed TEST does not exist and has not been run.

abstention.not_stored_in_weights: Qwen3's lm_head is nn.Linear(bias=False) with tied embeddings and no config flag for a head bias, so no checkpoint of this architecture can hold the constant. It is applied in forward, which is why this core needs trust_remote_code=True.
abstention.selection_status: POST-HOC gate, threshold selected on Showcase only; carried over unchanged from Supa-A1
abstention.loader_requirement: trust_remote_code=True. Without it the directory loads as plain Qwen3ForCausalLM with no gate and NO WARNING (121/192 instead of 125/192). Assert type(model).__name__ == 'Qwen3AbstainForCausalLM'.

statistical_position.summary: The abstention gate is worth a stable +4 (S4 form) to +7 (S1 form) on Stability across every numerical realisation tested. No configuration in this family is statistically distinguishable from any other, and the earlier S1 headline of 130/192 at p=0.0490 held only on the BF16 base+adapter arithmetic path.
statistical_position.power: At the observed effect the study has power 0.31 at n=192. Roughly 576 rows would be needed for 80% power.
statistical_position.effect_ci: S1 gate delta +7 rows, 95% paired-pack bootstrap CI [-1, +15]

caveats: No sealed TEST split exists for this suite; the corpus is 64 + 192 rows.
Stability192 has been read many times and is no longer a clean split.
The threshold is calibrated to this model only; on Rineya-Baya-1.7.0 the same gate lowers Showcase from 40 to 35.
Loading without trust_remote_code=True silently disables the gate.
Load in float16; a bfloat16 load re-rounds the weights and discards the precision this core exists to preserve.

containment_tolerant.note: Post-hoc scorer added after observing that 245 of 256 outputs grew. Reported as mechanism, not as a second significance claim. Audited: of the 17 rows it rescues, zero have a gold answer short enough for spurious substring matching.

decomposition.abstention: lost -- UNKNOWN emitted on 13 of 64 unanswerable rows by Supa, 2 by Opallo, identical under both scorers
decomposition.answerable_retrieval: intact -- 150 vs 149 on 192 rows under the tolerant scorer
decomposition.terse_formatting: lost -- 17 rows where the answer is correct but wrapped in a sentence, typically a leading article and a full stop

long_context_validation.instrument: Rineya_Long_Context_Demo_v1, all 256 rows, greedy, 24 new tokens
long_context_validation.note: Both Supa and Opallo measured in one session under Transformers 4.51.3, because the published 161/256 was produced under 5.14.1. Supa measured here reproduces the published total exactly (161/256; showcase 41 vs 40, stability 120 vs 121).

panel_validation.instrument: 150-row arithmetic word-problem panel (monitor_probe.jsonl), classes percentage_reasoning / ratio_proportion / time_duration
panel_validation.noise_floor_note: Same-config different-seed panel pairs on this instrument run 15-24 discordant rows. A single-seed panel count is not a significance claim; see NOISE_FLOOR.md.

puzzle_reasoning_validation.instrument: Rineya-Puzzle-Reasoning-51k, frozen 450-row test sample, 30 per family
puzzle_reasoning_validation.note: Both models sit at the guessing floor. Training neither gained nor cost puzzle reasoning. See PUZZLE_CEILING.md.

substitution.formula: bfloat16(base) with 220 trained tensors replaced by bfloat16(float32 trained value)
